$comment: Lighthouse thresholds (Gate 6, G6-1, APR-JE-038). They reproduce lighthouserc.json of Lighthouse CI exactly (the file this replaces): the same five pages, three runs per page, performance 0.8 (warn), accessibility 0.95 (error), best practices 0.9 (warn), SEO 0.6 (warn), is-crawlable not asserted. They may be raised, never lowered: check:selftest-gate6 holds the floor in 'floor'. 'aggregation' decides how three runs become one score: Lighthouse CI's default was 'optimistic' (a page passed when ANY run reached the minimum), which the Phase 6 documents wrongly described as the median. 'median' is the same as or stricter than 'optimistic' for every set of runs, so it weakens nothing; 'pessimistic' (every run must pass) is stricter still. Only 'error' assertions fail the command; 'warn' assertions are printed.

is-crawlable.reason: The demonstration is deliberately noindex (it is a fictional portfolio demonstration, never a real restaurant). Lighthouse's own audit would fail by design and would hold the SEO category below 1; the category threshold above is the assertion.
